wiring_rule: Every user action traces 9 steps: ui_source -> command -> canonical_owner -> validation_permission -> state_or_op -> event_receipt_observable -> ui_projection -> usage_diagnostic -> recovery_deeplink. No concept-only local state may masquerade as production wiring.

traces.ui_source: Formatter table 'Resolve' button on a language row where two formatters claim ownership (e.g. prettier + biome for typescript), inside the expanded Code & Execution destination.
traces.validation_permission: Validate effective_formatter_id is registered for the language and caller holds settings.formatter.manage; reject if owner not registered (404).
traces.state_or_op: Persistent mutation: set formatter.ownership[language].effective_owner, move prior co-claimants into demoted_owners[]; revision-tagged.
traces.event_receipt_observable: Emit formatter.ownership.resolved {language, effective_owner, demoted_owners[], scope, receipt_id}; ObservableOperation completes with a ReceiptLink.
traces.ui_projection: HealthSummary + FormatterResource cards update: effective owner shows 'effective' badge; demoted rows show 'not-effective' badge and lose the format-document route.
traces.usage_diagnostic: Attribute ownership change to settings.formatter.manage audit; record language + chosen owner for conflict-frequency diagnostics.
traces.recovery_deeplink: ReceiptLink deep-links back to the formatter table; undo restores prior ownership at prior revision.

traces.action: command dry-run (NEVER sends to an agent)
traces.ui_source: CommandEditor 'Dry run' button on a custom command, inside the dedicated Commands & Shortcuts destination.
traces.command: cmd.commands.custom.dry_run (alias of the dry-method guard family; catalog.settings_agent_rules_dry_method_default_guard_set is the related default-guard setting)
traces.validation_permission: HARD GATE: payload MUST carry dispatch_target=preview_only and agent_recipient=null; shell-safety scan + parameter completeness; permission commands.dry_run. Reject any payload that implies an agent recipient (422).
traces.state_or_op: Stateless operation: expand includes, substitute parameters, render a preview. NO agent dispatch. NO state mutation.
traces.event_receipt_observable: Emit command.dry_run.previewed {command_id, preview_payload, dispatch_target=preview_only, agent_recipient=null, warnings[]}; ObservableOperation yields a preview ReceiptLink. Invariant: this is never an agent dispatch event.
traces.ui_projection: Preview pane renders expanded body + warnings + shell-safety annotations; 'Send to agent' affordance is intentionally absent from the dry-run surface.
traces.usage_diagnostic: Increment commands.dry_run counter; record shell-safety warnings for the command id.
traces.recovery_deeplink: On shell_safety_violation or missing_parameter: deep-link to the offending segment in CommandEditor; user fixes and re-runs preview.

traces.ui_source: ShortcutRecorder capturing a new combo for an existing binding, inside Commands & Shortcuts.
traces.validation_permission: Validate combo syntax + caller holds settings.shortcuts.manage; run conflict detection against existing bindings + when-clauses.
traces.state_or_op: If conflict: do NOT overwrite silently — return combo_taken (409) with the conflicting binding(s). If clean: persistent mutation, move binding to new combo, revision-tagged.
traces.event_receipt_observable: On success emit shortcut.remapped {binding_id, combo, conflicts:[]}; ObservableOperation + ReceiptLink. On conflict emit shortcut.conflict_detected {combo, conflicting_bindings[]} (no mutation).
traces.ui_projection: ShortcutRecorder shows inline conflict list with the colliding command(s); conflict-handling policy row offers remap/reset; cheat-sheet updates on success.
traces.usage_diagnostic: Record conflict frequency per combo for shortcut-hygiene diagnostics.
traces.recovery_deeplink: Conflict: deep-link to cmd.shortcuts.conflict.resolve or reset; success: undo restores prior combo at prior revision.

traces.ui_source: MCP resource row 'Reconnect' button on a failed/remote server, inside the expanded system.mcp destination.
traces.validation_permission: Validate server_id registered + caller holds settings.mcp.manage; honor OAuth boundary (CLI-owned vs PM-direct vs remote headers).
traces.state_or_op: Operation: re-establish transport (stdio respawn / remote-url re-fetch / sse resume), re-probe exposed tools (lazy-exposure respected), update last_contact.
traces.event_receipt_observable: Emit mcp.server.reconnect.completed {server_id, transport, result: ok|failed, exposed_tools_count, last_contact}; ObservableOperation + ReceiptLink.
traces.ui_projection: MCP row health badge flips ok/failed; exposed-tools-of-total updates; AvailabilityReason explains any failure.
traces.usage_diagnostic: Attribute reconnect latency + result to system.mcp transport diagnostics; record per-server failure rate.
traces.recovery_deeplink: On failed: AvailabilityReason + retry ReceiptLink + deep-link to logs (cmd.mcp.server.open_logs); on auth_expired: route to the correct OAuth refresh flow per boundary.

traces.ui_source: Tool kind row 'Select for this turn' toggle inside the shared Skills manager (Tools kind axis).
traces.validation_permission: Validate tool_id is currently-available (rung 3 of 5) + caller holds tools.select_for_turn; reject if not currently_available (409).
traces.state_or_op: Transient per-turn mutation: set tool.lifecycle_state=selected-for-turn for turn_id; does NOT invoke. Idempotent within the turn.
traces.event_receipt_observable: Emit tool.lifecycle.changed {tool_id, kind, from_state: currently-available, to_state: selected-for-turn, turn_id}; ObservableOperation yields a selection ReceiptLink (no invocation).
traces.ui_projection: RequestedEffectiveInspector advances the ladder to rung 4 (selected-for-turn); 'invoked' rung 5 remains false until actual dispatch.
traces.usage_diagnostic: Attribute selection to the turn id for tool-selection diagnostics; track select-vs-invoke gap.
traces.recovery_deeplink: On not_currently_available: surface AvailabilityReason; selection can be toggled off within the same turn (idempotent revert).

traces.ui_source: LSP resource row 'Restart' action on a registered server, inside expanded Code & Execution > editing.
traces.validation_permission: Validate server_id registered + caller holds settings.lsp.manage; check formatting-ownership note if the server owns formatDocument.
traces.state_or_op: Operation: stop + restart the language server process; re-attach to open documents; preserve requested attachment (effective may degrade for remote).
traces.event_receipt_observable: Emit lsp.server.restarted {server_id, status, pid}; ObservableOperation + ReceiptLink; optionally lsp.formatting_ownership note if format owner changed.
traces.ui_projection: LSP card status flips restarted; RequestedEffectiveInspector re-evaluates effective attachment; problems list refreshes.
traces.usage_diagnostic: Attribute restart count + latency to LSP diagnostics; record if restart was user-initiated vs auto-restart (crash recovery).
traces.recovery_deeplink: On restart_failed: deep-link to logs (cmd.lsp.server.open_logs) + offer fallback to last-known-good config.

traces.ui_source: Formatter row 'Test' button, inside Code & Execution > editing formatter table.
traces.validation_permission: Validate formatter_id registered + caller holds settings.formatter.manage; sample_path readable.
traces.state_or_op: Stateless operation: locate binary (detected/not_found), run against sample, capture health + sample_diff. NOT a format-document dispatch on user files.
traces.event_receipt_observable: Emit formatter.test.completed {formatter_id, health: detected|not_found|disabled, sample_diff, warnings[]}; ObservableOperation + ReceiptLink.
traces.ui_projection: HealthSummary updates the row health badge; not_found surfaces SetupFlowLauncher; sample_diff renders inline.
traces.usage_diagnostic: Attribute probe result to formatter health diagnostics; record not_found frequency per formatter.
traces.recovery_deeplink: On not_found: SetupFlowLauncher offers install; on exit_nonzero: deep-link to command editor with stderr.

traces.ui_source: Destination row header click OR a search result OR an external deeplink — targeting a manager (e.g. Skills manager).
traces.validation_permission: Validate destination_id exists + caller holds settings.navigate; no sensitive permission (navigation is session projection).
traces.state_or_op: UI session state mutation: set active_destination_id + expanded=true + active_subcategory; push/pop FLIP depth on the expanded body. No persistent settings mutation.
traces.event_receipt_observable: Emit settings.destination.expanded {destination_id, expanded, active_subcategory, source}; session projection only (no persistent receipt).
traces.ui_projection: Destination row expands in place; sticky subnav pills render; manager ResourceList loads async (does not block workspace); setting_id (if any) focus-flashes.
traces.usage_diagnostic: Attribute navigation entry-point (row-click vs search vs deeplink) to settings-nav diagnostics.
traces.recovery_deeplink: On unknown_destination: fall back to stack top + search; collapse_all returns to stack top.

notes: All traces honor the CLI-owned vs PM-direct OAuth boundary: reconnect/auth steps route to the correct owner, never bypass CLI-owned OAuth.
No trace introduces SQLite or Playwright terminology; the only browser execution surface is the PM-native Browser Program (testing capability).
Dry-run (wire-002) is the strongest invariant: validation rejects any payload implying an agent recipient; the event is explicitly preview-only.
